messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall — P1: Greenline (dedicated VPC) auth failing for inference requests. Error: 'JWT verification failed: no matching keys' across multiple dedicated nodes. Auto-escalate to SRE and Sec-Ops.
maya.sre: seeing ~35% 401s from greenline tenant across pool-g1; started at ~08:03 UTC. Logs show JWKS fetch returning 504 from customer IdP behind their WAF.
trent.prodops: confirmed. Traffic spike when tokens rotated at customer side. Our cache TTL for JWKS is 24h; when their jwks_url returned 5xx it left us with stale keys -> verification fails.
jess.cse: greenline reports they rotated key material and their metadata endpoint had a transient misconfig; they just fixed it but we're still failing because our cached keys mismatch.
greenline-sre: we pushed new keys at 07:58 and had an internal outage on our IdP. It recovered at 08:05 but you might still have old keys. We're on standby to help rotate.
maya.sre: mitigation options: 1) purge jwks cache for greenline tenant across dedicated pool (fast), 2) temporarily relax verification to accept previous kid for 5m (risky), 3) route greenline traffic to backup hosted pool (possible but needs data path and privacy check). Thoughts?
trent.prodops: do 1) immediately. I'll run cache purge job targeting tenant_id=greenline, pool=dedicated-g1. Command: ```/ops purge-jwks-cache --tenant greenline --pool dedicated-g1 --force```
oncall-bot: Handoff to @maya.sre for active mitigation. Next handoff at 09:00 UTC.
maya.sre: running purge now. Patch notes: invalidating in-memory and redis caches, and sending cache-bust signal to runtime nodes. Will monitor.
jess.cse: also toggling retry/backoff for token fetch endpoints to avoid hammering their IdP while they stabilize.
sec-ops-bot: reminder: changing verification policies may increase risk - keep short window and coordinate with Greenline. Audit log required for any bypass.
maya.sre: purge completed at 08:12 UTC. Rerouting a few sample requests show JWT verification passing now. Monitoring error rate.
greenline-sre: we see retries from your side, thanks. Our IdP served proper JWKS at 08:10. We'll keep it stable.
trent.prodops: error rate dropped from 35% to ~2% after purge. Rolling through all nodes now.
jess.cse: starting canary traffic for more sensitive endpoints (payments) to ensure no silent failures.
maya.sre: canary good for 10min, then full restore.
oncall-bot: Incident update: Mitigation applied, partial recovery observed. Continue monitoring.
sec-ops-bot: postmortem checklist: capture jwks cache TTL config, add tenant-specific healthcheck for jwks_url, add backoff + circuit-breaker for jwks fetch, and consider shorter cache with signed key rotation window handling.
greenline-sre: request: can you add a quick manual override we can trigger if our IdP has short outages? Would help avoid customer-visible 401s.
jess.cse: we can add a tenant-scoped 'accept-previous-kid' toggle in the auth proxy for emergencies; will need RBAC so only SRE + CS can trigger.
maya.sre: action items: A1) Add tenant JWKS healthcheck (trent) A2) Implement purge tool logging + retries (maya) A3) Design emergency 'accept-previous-kid' toggle with audit (jess + sec-ops) A4) Customer runbook update (greenline + jess). I'll open the incident ticket and assign.
trent.prodops: created INC-2025-4872 with mitigation timeline and links to logs.
maya.sre: starting 1h watch. tagging #postmortem for follow-up.
oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled to @trent.prodops at 09:00 UTC for next watch window.
maya.sre: small follow-up: observed one node still returning 401s due to stale local file cache; remote command to restart runtime on node node-gnl-07 fixed it. Marking node restart in incident log.
jess.cse: will draft postmortem, include exact timestamps, root cause (IdP rotation + transient 5xx), and proposed engineers + timelines.
greenline-sre: thanks for the fast response. We'll coordinate changes to rotation schedule and notify you before future rotations.
trent.prodops: closing thread for the immediate outage; keeping incident open for postmortem and action items. :white_check_mark:
